object.name: evi.list.xfade
object.description: A simple abstraction wrapper for crossfading between two lists set in the right and left inlets. Lists are interpolated with a 0..1 float.
object.discussion: Thanks to Vincent Goudard who made the original version of this abstraction.

inlets.description: List 1 to crossfade to. Left list triggers at current crossfade value.
List 2 to crossfade from. Cold, unless @hot attribute is set.

outlets.description: List result of crossfading list 2 to list 1

attributes.name: hot
attributes.description: Set the right list inlet to also be hot, so that changes in both inlets trigger the list crossfade.

attributes.name: init
attributes.description: Trigger the set crossfade amount on instantiation if on (1).

attributes.name: maxsize
attributes.description: Maximum list size on which to operate. Reduce this to save resources as the default is the maximum.

attributes.name: setxfade
attributes.description: Set an initial crossfade amount. This can then be triggered with a list or a bang into the left inlet.
